description: List every open document, not just the frontmost one. Returns document_id (stable for this session), name, saved, path (empty when never saved), page_count, is_active and managed_story_count (stories linked to an editorial workflow such as InCopy; null when unreadable). Read-only. Note: saved true is no reliable sign that there is nothing to save.
name: list_documents
title: List open documents
